dashboard.label: Splunk Detection Lab
dashboard.description: Four ATT&CK-mapped detections run against the OTRF empire_mimikatz_logonpasswords dataset (index=otrf).

search.query: index=otrf EventID=10 TargetImage="*\\lsass.exe" | eval access=tonumber(replace(GrantedAccess,"0x",""),16) | where floor(access/16)%2=1 OR like(CallTrace,"%UNKNOWN%") | stats count

index=otrf Channel="Windows PowerShell" EventID=400 | rex field=Message "HostApplication=(?<HostApplication>[^\r\n]+)" | where match(HostApplication, "(?i)\s[-/]e[a-z]*\s+[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{20,}") | stats count

index=otrf Channel="Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational" EventID=7 | eval dll=lower(mvindex(split(ImageLoaded,"\\"),-1)) | search dll IN ("samlib.dll","vaultcli.dll","cryptdll.dll","winscard.dll","hid.dll","netapi32.dll","wkscli.dll","netutils.dll","logoncli.dll","wldap32.dll","dpapi.dll") | stats dc(dll) as dll_count by Hostname Image ProcessId | where dll_count>=4 | stats count

index=otrf Channel="Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational" EventID=3 Initiated=true NOT DestinationIp IN ("0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1","::1","127.0.0.1") | sort 0 _time | streamstats current=f last(_time) as prev_time by Hostname Image DestinationIp DestinationPort | eval gap=_time-prev_time | stats count as connections avg(gap) as avg_gap stdev(gap) as jitter by Hostname Image DestinationIp DestinationPort | where connections>=3 AND jitter < avg_gap/2 | stats count

index=otrf EventID=10 TargetImage="*\\lsass.exe" | eval access=tonumber(replace(GrantedAccess,"0x",""),16) | where floor(access/16)%2=1 OR like(CallTrace,"%UNKNOWN%") | table _time Hostname SourceImage GrantedAccess CallTrace

index=otrf Channel="Windows PowerShell" EventID=400 | rex field=Message "HostApplication=(?<HostApplication>[^\r\n]+)" | where match(HostApplication, "(?i)\s[-/]e[a-z]*\s+[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{20,}") | eval HostApplication=substr(HostApplication,1,120)."..." | table _time Hostname HostApplication

index=otrf Channel="Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational" EventID=7 | eval dll=lower(mvindex(split(ImageLoaded,"\\"),-1)) | search dll IN ("samlib.dll","vaultcli.dll","cryptdll.dll","winscard.dll","hid.dll","netapi32.dll","wkscli.dll","netutils.dll","logoncli.dll","wldap32.dll","dpapi.dll") | stats dc(dll) as dll_count values(dll) as dlls min(_time) as first max(_time) as last by Hostname Image ProcessId | eval span_ms=round((last-first)*1000) | where dll_count>=4 | table Hostname Image ProcessId dll_count span_ms dlls

index=otrf Channel="Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational" EventID=3 Initiated=true NOT DestinationIp IN ("0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1","::1","127.0.0.1") | sort 0 _time | streamstats current=f last(_time) as prev_time by Hostname Image DestinationIp DestinationPort | eval gap=_time-prev_time | stats count as connections avg(gap) as avg_gap stdev(gap) as jitter by Hostname Image DestinationIp DestinationPort | eval avg_gap=round(avg_gap,1), jitter=round(jitter,2) | where connections>=3 AND jitter < avg_gap/2
index=otrf | stats count by Channel | sort -count
